content.text: Section 11 is directly on point and exceeds the preferred position.

input.quote: 11.1 Upon expiry or termination for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at the rates in the expiring Order Form. Assistance includes knowledge transfer, export support, cooperation with a replacement supplier, orderly migration, and continued service at the then-current scope and service levels.
input.rationale: Section 11 meets the preferred position in full: six months of transition assistance on request (priced at the expiring Order Form rates, which is better for us than "then-current rates"), return of all Customer Data within thirty days in a complete, commonly used, documented, machine-readable format with metadata, and secure deletion with written officer certification thereafter. Two customer-favourable extras: Vendor may not withhold Customer Data over a fee dispute (p0048), and deletion is triggered only after we confirm successful return, with any law-required retained copy remaining protected (p0049). Section 10.1 preserves our Customer Data rights and expressly contemplates the transition period, so nothing conditions data return on payment. No redline required.
